summary: Description Curriculum Instructors Nutritional Medicine In Neurology Teaching Method System Requirements This is the second of six courses in the ROHP-Qualifying Program (Registered Orthomolecular Health Practitioners). This course consists of three sections (each lesson has its own exam): Nutritional Medicine and the Nervous System Part 1: Brain Development, ADHD and Neurodegenerative Disease (Alzheimer’s disease, Dementia, Parkinson’s disease, Multiple Sclerosis, Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis)...
